profile_text.body:
AppLovin Corp is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, traded under the ticker APP and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001751008. Its site describes it as an advertising business built for mobile games, saying it reaches over a billion daily users in that setting and helps consumer brands and gaming apps scale profitably. The company lists consumer brands, gaming apps, and agencies among the audiences it serves, and points visitors to a dashboard, a Shopify app, a pixel helper, and a strategy call booking option.

The ad formats it describes are fullscreen placements that run during natural pauses in a game or are chosen by users in exchange for rewards, rather than appearing in a scrollable feed. The site gives jewelry, furniture, fitness subscriptions, and word games as examples of the kinds of businesses it works with.

The record also carries the alias APPLOVIN CORP-CLASS A. No lawsuits are listed against the company, and California appears as a jurisdiction of legal exposure. No MCP servers or tracked products are listed.
